description: reload 後の load と tick、および同じ tick 内の tick 関数と反復コマンドブロックの順序
setup: data modify storage m2:clock trace set value []

m2:clock/load: data modify storage m2:clock trace append value {source:"load"}
m2:clock/tick: data modify storage m2:clock trace append value {source:"tick"}
execute store result storage m2:clock trace[-1].tick int 1 run scoreboard players get #tick clock
m2:clock/block: data modify storage m2:clock trace append value {source:"block"}
execute store result storage m2:clock trace[-1].tick int 1 run scoreboard players get #tick clock

actions.run: data modify storage m2:clock after_reload set from storage m2:clock trace
